notes.title: One button to rule them all!
notes.notes:
Skirmish is a 1 vs 1 brawler. In arena or tournament mode you play directly against your friends (or AI). The twist, however, is that you each only have one button to control up to three characters. 

You press it, you jump. You let go, you attack. You hold it, you run. You double-tap, you turn around. Combat is wonky and physics-based. You can roll, spin, wobble, deflect arrows, and so forth.

There's a range of factions, weapons and fighting styles to choose from. In the demo you get to try a few of them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34056617/233a97d13332bd5da9d6f97ed446f2c6061c89ad.png[/img]

If 1 vs 1 is not your thing, there's also a campaign that can be played cooperatively. The demo features a couple of levels that we have selected from across the final game. It should take to 15-20 minutes to complete.

So give it a go; alone, with or against some friends. We're eager to hear what you think!
